HELLO, LOOPRA.

Calm, in layers.

Loopra is a small instrument for unhurried listening. Thirty-two original sound layers turn at different lengths, so their encounters keep changing.

The pads and bowed bass overlap to make a continuous bed. Bells, felt piano, fine ripples, discreet arpeggios, soft breaths and rare little calls drift through it. Every pitched layer belongs to the same musical mode.

Number of loops
Sets how many layers are enabled. Individual switches update this number too.
New loop lengths
Draws a new set of periods while keeping your chosen sounds.
Harmonic complexity
Moves from open, simple voicings to softly spaced seventh, ninth, eleventh and thirteenth colors.
Headphones · Solo
Listen to one layer on its own, including layers that are switched off. A short audition plays immediately; the layer then follows its own loop. Click the same headphones again to restore your chosen mix.
Save setup
Keeps your selection, key, mode, volume and loop lengths as a small JSON file.

All sound is synthesized here. No account, samples, model downloads, tracking or external audio services. Closing or reloading the page stops playback; settings are remembered in this browser.
